review_findings_resolved_by_root: Partition report was read but not validated against actual labels and P0 graph;current code binds all fields and checks coverage/capacity
Coordinate0 fallback previously retained tiny residual coordinates;current code zeroes the vector before coordinate0 assignment
Added explicit fit/base shape and fixed protocol checks
Added initialization-validation and whole model-command work timing
schema_note: Earlier partition source used COMPLETE_GRAPH_PARTITION;latest actual partition source/schema uses COMPLETE and the builder correctly checks COMPLETE. No assumption based on a stale schema is retained.
statistical_interpretation: Profiles and frequency portals are preregistered fit-only heuristics;neither optimizes measured online search utility.
fit_mean_distinct_gt10_regions and fit_top4_oracle_target_mass describe training target concentration only;they do not establish pilot oracle search gain or P2 PASS.
No query from pilot/validation/heldout influences profile/portal computation. read_fvecs/read_ivecs load the parent router_train file,then slice before all fitting and hash checking.
Fallback incidence should be reported per dataset;not silently pooled with learned region profiles.
Zero/tiny query vectors are left zero by epsilon normalization;the current P0 audited source is authoritative. A near-zero cancelling portal fallback is covered synthetically.
limitations: Review verifies current source against protocol and small existing logs;no large data were read and no new model was fit by this reviewer.
Base and GT identity rely on current P0 checks plus fit-value hashes;no redundant full base/GT checksum scan was performed.
This is model-construction correctness review,not a new-method performance gate.
